incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: prod-embed-queue high-5xx-rate (P2) — page PD-987654. Alerts: 5xx spike > 15% across eu-west. Auto-bridge created.

alex: ack

alex: I'm on it, taking ownership. pinging eng-oncall.

sara: thanks alex — do we know customer impact yet? any high-traffic tenants?

alex: quick check — top-5 tenants show increased errors, looks like batching-related 500s from embed worker. attaching quick logs.

alex: ```
2026-03-15T13:12:02Z embed-worker-12 ERROR request_handler.go:234 failed to process batch: invalid kv cache state
2026-03-15T13:12:02Z embed-worker-12 ERROR stack: kvcache/evict.go:88
```

mike: jumping in — could be kv cache thrash after recent autoscaler tweak. I rolled a tweak to autoscaler at ~12:45UTC earlier.

jessie: tagged support-team: we should prepare a short customer message if impact persists. any ETA?

alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale up dedicated embed pool by +2 nodes (temp) 2) rollback recent autoscaler change if scaling doesn't stabilize 3) enable extra request-level retries for embeds. Doing step 1 now.

incident-bot: Runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-5xx-spike|embeddings 5xx runbook>

alex: kubectl output for scaling (running):
```
$ kubectl scale deployment/embed-dedicated --replicas=10 -n prod-eu
deployment.apps/embed-dedicated scaled
```

alex: curl healthcheck against a couple pods: one pod returned 200, others still returning 502/500. propagating but error rate going down slightly ~ from 18% to 12%

mike: I can kick the rollback for the autoscaler in 10m if metrics don't hit <5%. tagging @sara for customer impact decision.

sara: ok — support-team, flag top-2 customers with increased error rates and prepare a targeted note with mitigation steps + ETA. No public incident page yet unless impact >20% or customer-visible latency increase.

support-team: acknowledged. pulling tenant list and will DM customer success owners.

jessie: alex, can you confirm whether fallback routing to hosted embeddings is available for affected tenants?

alex: yes — routing policy exists. Not switching yet to avoid extra latency for customers who are sensitive. If error rate >15% sustained for 20m we'll enable fallback for heavy tenants.

incident-bot: PD-987654 status updated: acknowledged by alex. Auto-escalation window paused.

alex: status: increased replicas applied, observed error rate drop to 9% over last 5m. Will keep monitoring. If stable for 15 min, mark as resolved and follow up with postmortem.

mike: if we see KV eviction errors again I have a patch to add a defensive check, can run as hotfix.

sara: good work. alex, hold the bridge for now; if you need a handoff to oncall-manager or SRE escalate here. Support-team, temp customer messages only.

alex: will update every 10 minutes or on major change.

incident-bot: Bridge closed automatically (no active participants) — but thread remains for followups.

alex: closing note: we stabilized with +2 replicas; autoscaler rollback not yet needed. I'll open a ticket to investigate root cause (kv cache eviction regressions) and schedule a postmortem. tagging "postmortem" in ops board.

sara: request: include a clear list of tenants impacted and timeline in the postmortem. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
